title: AlignedSegmentsSchema
description: Intermediate output of the Synthesis stage. Pairs each slide occurrence with the transcript text spoken during it.

segments.description: Time-ordered segments. Includes 'general_discussion' entries for transcript content not anchored to any slide.

slide_id.description: Matches slide_id in SlideTimelineSchema. Null for 'general_discussion' segments.

occurrence_index.description: 0-based index of this occurrence within a slide's appearances. 0 for general_discussion.

slide_content.description: Slide content for this segment. Null for general_discussion segments.

transcript_text.description: Concatenated utterance text for the slide's time window. May be empty if no transcript was available.

duration_seconds.description: Length of this segment's on-screen time in seconds.

start_seconds.description: Playback position when this segment started.

SlideContentRef.description: Inlined SlideContent for this segment (copy from SlideContentSchema for self-contained segment records).
